key_findings: 96% of website visitors are not ready to buy on their first visit, meaning hard-sell pages fail to convert cold traffic.
80% of new leads generated never convert into a sale, highlighting a breakdown in lead nurturing and friction during the conversion process.
Websites frequently attract visitors but fail to generate enquiries due to hidden Call-to-Actions (CTAs), weak trust signals, poor user experience (UX), and unclear messaging.
pain_points: Spending money on ads or SEO traffic but receiving zero or very low form submissions and customer enquiries.
Confusion over whether lead generation failure stems from bad design, lack of SEO, or ineffective copywriting.
Treating the website as a static digital brochure rather than a designed lead capture funnel.
research.chosen_angle: Shift from 'Brochure Website' to 'Lead Engine': Fixing the 3 Hidden Friction Points Blocking Conversions
research.angle_reason: Directly targets business owners who waste ad spend bringing traffic to a site that lacks clear CTAs, trust signals, and nurturing hooks, giving them immediate actionable clarity.
